sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS SME_Avg_Consumption,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS LAM_Avg_Consumption,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS KAM_Avg_Consumption
FROM "yearmonth"
WHERE Date = '201301'
AND Date = '201312'
GROUP BY Segment
HAVING Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
ORDER BY Segment

sql:
SELECT 
    m.first_name, 
    m.last_name, 
    m.phone
FROM 
    "expense" e
JOIN 
    "member" m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN 
    "budget" b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE 
    e.cost > (SELECT AVG(e2.cost) FROM "expense" e2)
GROUP BY 
    m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId

    s.full_name,
    s.eye_colour_id,
    s.hair_colour_id,
    s.skin_colour_id,
    s.gender,
    s.publisher_name
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN 
    gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE 
    g.gender = 'Female'
    AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
ORDER BY 
    s.full_name

    s.full_name,
    s.eye_colour_id,
    s.hair_colour_id,
    s.skin_colour_id,
    s.gender,
    s.publisher_name
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN 
    gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id

ORDER BY 
    s.full_name;

```sql
SELECT s.school_name, s.doc_type
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.CharterSchool = 1 AND f.FundingType = 'LOCALLY FUNDING'
AND (s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) > (
    SELECT AVG (Enrollment (K-12) - Enrollment (Ages 5-17))
    FROM frpm f2
    WHERE f2.CharterSchool = 1 AND f2.FundingType = 'LOCALLY FUNDING'
)
ORDER BY s.school_name;
